title: Interpretable PM2.5 Forecasting for Urban Air Quality: A Comparative Study of Adaptive Time-Series Models
abstract: arXiv:2603.25495v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Accurate short-term air-quality forecasting is essential for public health protection and urban management, yet many recent forecasting frameworks rely on complex, data-intensive, and computationally demanding models. This study investigates whether lightweight and interpretable forecasting approaches can provide competitive performance for hourly PM2.5 prediction in Beijing, China. Using multi-year pollutant and meteorological time-series data, we developed a leakage-aware forecasting workflow that combined chronological data partitioning, preprocessing, feature selection, and exogenous-driver modeling under the Perfect Prognosis setting. Three forecasting families were evaluated: SARIMAX, Facebook Prophet, and NeuralProphet. To assess practical deployment behavior, the models were tested under two adaptive regimes: weekly walk-forward refitting and frozen forecasting with online residual correction. Results showed clear differences

translated_title: 面向城市空气质量的可解释PM2.5预测：自适应时间序列模型的比较研究
translated_abstract: 准确的短期空气质量预测对于公共健康保护和城市管理至关重要，然而近来许多预测框架依赖于复杂、数据密集且计算开销巨大的模型。本研究探讨了轻量级且可解释的预测方法能否在中国北京的小时级PM2.5预测中提供有竞争力的性能。利用多年污染物与气象时间序列数据，我们构建了一种防止数据泄露的预测工作流程，该流程在完美预报（Perfect Prognosis）设置下结合了按时间顺序的数据划分、预处理、特征选择和外生驱动因素建模。研究评估了三种预测模型家族：SARIMAX、Facebook Prophet和NeuralProphet。为评估模型在实际部署中的表现，研究在两种自适应机制下对模型进行了测试：每周滚动前向重拟合，以及带在线残差校正的冻结预测。结果显示出明显的差异
tldr: 本研究比较了SARIMAX、Prophet和NeuralProphet三种轻量级可解释模型在北京小时级PM2.5预测中的表现，并评估了每周滚动重拟合与冻结预测加在线残差校正两种自适应部署策略的实际效果。
en_tdlr: This study compares three lightweight interpretable models (SARIMAX, Facebook Prophet, and NeuralProphet) for hourly PM2.5 forecasting in Beijing, evaluating their performance under two adaptive deployment regimes: weekly walk-forward refitting and frozen forecasting with online residual correction.
